result.stdout:
Description:
  Generates a REST HTTP API client from an OpenAPI description file.

Usage:
  requesty [options]

Options:
  --openapi <path>                                                                                                                                                        The path or URI to the OpenAPI description file used to generate the code files.
  --output <path>                                                                                                                                                         The output directory path for the generated code files. [default: ./output]
  --internal-type-access-modifiers                                                                                                                                        Makes every generated type internal instead of public.
  --namespace-name <name>                                                                                                                                                 The root namespace to use for the generated handlers and models. [default: ApiSdk]
  --client-name <name>                                                                                                                                                    The prefix of the client's root type names: {name}Consts, {name}JsonContext, {name}RequestBase, and {name}ResponseBase. Give each client in one project its own name. Defaults to Client.
  --http-client-name <name>                                                                                                                                               The name the generated handlers dispatch under (ClientConsts.HttpClientName, or {name}Consts with --client-name): the IHttpClientFactory client name and the key of the client's JSON options. Defaults to the description's info.title, or the namespace name when the title is missing.
  --log-level <Critical|Debug|Error|Information|None|Trace|Warning>                                                                             
[truncated]
